APPROVE — SourceRef/Ledger manifest S3 at babf7b73bfb707b76edce7559464301ca33482cb, tree c3198455655506fe8a6a31d0a6c09a13e282b128; reviewed delta from6e763f95a0100b2bf4f818cbcef598712502e0c2. No blocking defect found in this bounded review. Author/main/S4/UI-D worktrees preserved.

File evidence: ScientificManifest.scala:217 defines typed LedgerSource endpoints/discriminator; :474 enforces at most one source per role and a primary for every source-linked ledger; :584 parses unknown source roles as typed CodecError.Field. ArtifactResolution.scala:742 verifies source bytes into strict UTF-8 text; :1098 checks complete declared parser/options and the primary/inventory relation count, presence, expected inventory identity and inventory description. Primary/inventory descriptions sharing ArtifactRole.ImportSpec cannot substitute for each other. withImportSpecs and Delegating forwarding at:324/:449 retain explicit registration. Pure resolution does not fabricate VerifiedAdmission. ManifestReverification.scala:27-71 requires the named ledger, exact primary binding, LedgerOf input and required inventory text before invoking the existing complete semantic source verifier. Missing/legacy source bindings are typed refusals. The new two diagnostic cases append with operand projection/catalog coverage. Existing frozen manifest resource/fixture files are unchanged from integration parent.

Independent checks: new IndependentSourceManifestReviewSuite (SHA256 02473df93827e269130a70359b8e68a145b93f60227f557e60f673cccaaa1d1c) in separate detached .claude/worktrees/review-source-manifest-babf7b7, copied under /private/tmp/eyes4s-source-manifest-review-babf7b7. Seven tests on BOTH JVM and JS cover content-addressed manifest roundtrip, equal decoded input and CRLF/LF replay; deletion of each of two independently rejected records after pure ledger acceptance; eight same-hash dispersion42 variants (2 trials x2 fixations x2 methods) that survive manifest reconstruction and refuse with exact source/nonzero locations/differing operands; re-declared altered source bytes that resolve but fail replay; two ledgers cross-linked to each other's sources with identical parsers/options, both refused by replay; inventory-spec substitution for primary description; and source-less legacy ledgers remaining readable but unverified.

Fresh author checks additionally pass primary/inventory identity/description and missing inventory-link guards, UTF-8 and byte corruption, typed unknown roles, missing registration/default implementation and decorators, original S1 structural evidence regression, codec/io diagnostic catalogs, frozen @1 byte/address fixtures and JVM resource-backed resolution.

Command: GITHUB_ACTIONS=true sbt -J-Xmx8g 'ioJVM/testOnly *IndependentSourceManifestReviewSuite *ManifestReverificationSuite *LedgerReverificationSuite *IoDiagnosticCatalogSuite' 'codecJVM/testOnly *SourceManifestSuite *ManifestV1Suite *ManifestV1JvmSuite *InputsManifestV1Suite *InputsManifestV1JvmSuite *CodecDiagnosticCatalogSuite' 'ioJS/testOnly *IndependentSourceManifestReviewSuite *ManifestReverificationSuite' 'codecJS/testOnly *SourceManifestSuite *ManifestV1Suite *InputsManifestV1Suite'. PASS109 tests (37+38+13+21), no failures/skips, exit0,204.169608s. Raw focused.log and metadata in /private/tmp/eyes4s-source-manifest-review-babf7b7. Existing no-tag git-describe message is harmless; no new compiler warning failure.

Limits: exact-SHA bounded review only. No production edits, acceptance/status change, full audit, publishing consumer, main merge/push, bounded-execution/cancellation or authenticity claim. API audit baseline is intentionally stale until final integration re-record; it is not qualification for this candidate. S4 coexistence still needs final lead merge reconciliation; this verdict does not automatically transfer to that combined tree.
